sac.q: Where do I drop my bag?
sac.a: Bag drop at the Bellerive-Plage finish (supervised, with bib). Tent 08:00–17:00. No start-to-finish transfer (420 m).

semi.a: Half marathon start 08:40 at Place de Milan (2026; confirm for 2027). Nine waves every 4 minutes.

dossard.q: Where do I collect my bib?
dossard.a: Auguste Piccard sports hall, Ch. de Bellerive 36. 2026: Fri 15–18, Sat 11–18, Sun 07–14.

ravito.a: 2026: Km 0 Milan · 5 Lutry · 11 Cully · 15 Lutry · 16 Paudex · 19 Olympic Museum · 21 Bellerive.

prix.a: 2026 entry: CHF 63.– (medal & tee per Prices & Categories). 2027 fees TBC.
